messages.text:
The Bluetooth speaker refund proposal is for R$149.65. You must confirm it using the button on the proposal card; a message in chat won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).

The refund can only go to the order’s original payment, not your sister’s bank account. If you accept the original-payment refund, you can confirm the proposal; the refund will be recorded against that original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).

messages.text: My sister has my permission to receive the refund, but I don’t want it sent to the original payment.

I can’t send the refund to another person’s account or anywhere other than the order’s original payment. Your permission doesn’t change that, and I can’t make an exception (refund-policy/v2/payment). The proposal remains available if you want the refund to go to the original payment.
